topics.name: Transcripts
topics.description: Academic records issued and exchanged between institutions.

valueDrivers.name: Student mobility
valueDrivers.description: Students move between institutions without losing credit for what they have learned.

useCases.title: Verify the student's identity
useCases.description: Confirm that the person making a request is the student whose record it concerns.

useCases.title: Send a transcript to another institution
useCases.description: A student asks their institution to send an official transcript to the institution they are transferring to.
useCases.frequency: About 300 per week, peaking at term end
useCases.precondition: The student has completed at least one term.
useCases.trigger: The student requests a transcript be sent.
useCases.successGuarantees: The receiving institution has a complete, verifiable record of the student's courses, credits and GPA.
useCases.failureGuarantees: No record has left the institution, and the student knows why.

steps.title: Student requests a transcript be sent
steps.statement: As a student I want to request my transcript be sent so that I can transfer.
acceptanceCriteria: The request identifies the student and the receiving institution.

data.note: Person Identifier of the requesting student
How the student wants it delivered; CEDS has no element for it

steps.title: Registrar assembles the transcript
steps.statement: As a registrar I want to assemble the student's courses and totals so that the record is complete.
acceptanceCriteria: Cumulative credits and GPA are included.

steps.title: Sending system delivers the transcript
steps.statement: As the sending system I want to deliver the transcript so that the receiving institution gets an official copy.

data.note: How the transcript is delivered; CEDS has no element for it

steps.title: Receiving system loads the transcript
steps.statement: As the receiving system I want to load the transcript so that transfer credit can be evaluated.
acceptanceCriteria: The student is matched or created from the identifier and name.

extensions.label: 2a
extensions.condition: The student has an unpaid hold.

steps.title: Registrar tells the student about the hold

extensions.label: 4a
extensions.condition: The receiving system cannot match the student.

steps.title: Receiving registrar matches the student by hand

useCases.otherInformation: Delivered within 2 business days of the request.
openIssues: What if the receiving institution only accepts paper?
How long is a sent transcript kept?

transitions.rationale: Extensions cover holds and unmatched students; every step's data is tied to CEDS.
transitions.changeNote: Added open issues, timing and the release.

transitions.rationale: Checked the actors, the invoked use case and every data link after upload.
